dataset.labels: graded 0/1/2 with an uncertainty flag; single AI annotator, no independent review

metadata.relevance_rule: lenient point estimate: a project is relevant when its grade is >= 1, uncertain labels at face value
metadata.aggregation: per-query score, then macro average over all queries; a query with no relevant projects scores 0 and stays in the denominator
metadata.duplicate_results: a repeated project id is counted once, at its first position

retrieval.note: same HybridRetriever class, index and database the application uses; the sweep changes only DENSE_WEIGHT and SPARSE_WEIGHT

ceiling.definition: mean score of a perfect ranking (all relevant projects first) under the same labels and cutoff; an upper bound, not a target

production.label: hybrid
